MOSS-TTS-Nano 100M / MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer-Nano
OpenMOSS and contributors
https://github.com/OpenMOSS/MOSS-TTS-Nano/tree/8b7bcc9341b3b4ef3a3a58ba1338a7d85ff133eb

Speech model and preset prompt-code source:
https://huggingface.co/OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-TTS-Nano-100M-ONNX/tree/f52645cb467506d8e18e746ddd59482685b74e58
Audio tokenizer / reference encoder:
https://huggingface.co/OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-Audio-Tokenizer-Nano-ONNX/tree/ceff0d0749bfb3fa2d61149794ec6feef0d1e1ae

The upstream repository and model metadata declare Apache License 2.0.
See LICENSE.MOSS for the full text. Thru3D uses an adapted native inference
implementation, locally prepared INT8 weights and 12 selected preset prompt
codes. Original reference recordings are not included in the application.
The packaged model and encoder files are pinned by model.json and clone_model.json.

The model license is not a separate verification of the provenance or rights
of every reference recording used to create preset prompt codes. That
recording-by-recording review remains unresolved.
